observations.title: Outdoor / complex backgrounds produce artifacts
observations.description: Source images photographed outdoors or against busy, texture-heavy backgrounds produce outputs with multiple unwanted surface textures, incorrect limb positions, and background detail bleeding into the rendered mannequin.
observations.likely_cause: ControlNet conditioning competes with the background signal during diffusion. The model fills non-pose regions with textures drawn from the source image context rather than neutral studio space. The pose skeleton may also be noisier when extracted from a cluttered background.
what_to_try: Pre-process outdoor source images with background removal (rembg, SAM) before pose extraction
Test higher cond_scale (1.75-2.0) to force the model to prioritise pose signal over background noise
Add 'outdoor background, natural background, grass, foliage, floor texture' to neg_prompt

observations.title: Prone back-bends not captured correctly by pose estimator
observations.description: Asanas with prone back-bends (e.g. Bhujangasana / Cobra, Dhanurasana / Bow, Ustrasana / Camel) produce outputs where the pose is wrong or the figure is distorted.
observations.likely_cause: DWPose / OpenPose struggle with limb occlusion in prone orientation and unusual body plane orientation. Keypoints may be mirrored or swapped left/right.
what_to_try: Compare DWPose vs MediaPipe skeleton output for this pose family
Test lower cond_scale (1.0-1.2) so the diffusion model can self-correct a partially wrong skeleton
Consider a dedicated profile (yoga_asana_prone) with adjusted conditioning
